reviews.text: I used StormPros to remodel my 1990s outdated fireplace and I’m so happy with the results. They went above and beyond in every regard….communication, job quality and getting the job done very quickly! I highly recommend them for any repair needs you may have!
reviews.author: Emily Dominguez

reviews.text: Great job by Steve Ray and the Storm Pros team replacing my leaky patio roof cover! They did it all in one day and did a good job with the cleanup. I would highly recommend them!!!
reviews.author: Eddie Robeson

reviews.text: My neighbor immediately connected me with Omar to fix some roof damage from a recent windstorm. While I was away from home, Omar sent me photos of the steps involved and got the job done quickly. He was wonderful to work with, and if needed, I will not hesitate to call Storm Pros again.
reviews.author: Niki Maas

reviews.text: My roof had storm damage and Storm Pros provided excellent service from begining to end. They were very responsive and professional as well as providing me with information on the process and kept me updated throughout it all. I appreciate the attention to detail and quality work they provided and took care of it like if it was their homes. They made the whole process stress free. I would highly recommended Storm Pros to anyone is the DFW area.
reviews.author: Luis Murillo

reviews.text: During the severe winter temperatures Texas had to endure many of us had lost our power and water. I left my apartment along with my partner to ensure his parents were safe as they are older. While we were there a pipe bursted and flooded the first floor of their home. We scrambled to drain and mediate what we could that entire day. We were exhausted and without water. I rang several companies and all plumbers/restoration services were completely booked for weeks. I came across Storm Pros by reference and they were our saving grace. I spoke to Omar and he helped us entirely. I appreciated his patience, understanding, and urgency. Him, I believe Steve, and his crew helped our family in our time of need and we are so so so thankful for that. Speaking with them felt like I was speaking with family. They took such great care in their work and explained their process to us. I highly recommend this company to trust and provide great service!
reviews.author: Jennifer Garcia

reviews.text:
Storm Pros gave us a estimate and date of when our roof would be prepared and they followed through on everything!

I appreciated that Omar kept us informed of everything happening such as materials ordered and timing. He also kept us informed of the weather in case we had to change anything. Their crew was on time when they showed up and got the job done in no time. I was also very thankful for the warning Omar gave us in taking care of our dog prior to coming out.

His crew covered up our pool to make sure no debris would fall in it. When they cleaned up, it was as if they were never there!

Very pleased with their professionalism and great job done! Thank y’all so much!
reviews.author: Kris Contreras

reviews.text: Integrity, honesty and a focus on excellence is what I experienced. Storm Pros literally rescued me after my home flooded! Everything that needed to be done was done professionally and they knew exactly what needed to be done to save what was left of my home and they documented everything so that my insurance was satisfied and paid my claim without question! So professional, efficient and fast. Don't use anyone else, this is on of the last of the honest companies left!
reviews.author: Ralph Castillo

reviews.text: Omar and Steve were super quick in showing up and performing an emergency repair after the crazy windstorm we just had. I was out of town and they managed to get the repair done for me and my neighbor the same day.
reviews.author: Ankesh Srivastava

data.summary: The reviews for Storm Pros appear highly authentic. The detailed, varied, and emotionally genuine stories from customers, coupled with specific names and project types, strongly indicate real experiences. The lack of any negative reviews in the sample and the perfect 5.0 rating with only 43 reviews over 9 years is a minor caution, but the content quality outweighs this concern. The BBB A+ rating with no complaints supports a positive reputation.

positive_evidence: Descriptions of follow-up and quality work imply standing behind their job
Reviewer mentions they 'will not hesitate to call again' if needed

authentic_signals: Specific project details (fireplace remodel, leaky patio roof, wind damage)
Mention of crew names (Omar, Steve Ray)
Emotional authenticity in stories (flood rescue, helping elderly parents)
